what: COMPILE-LIMIT (2026-10-24): every P-IND (torch.compile, Inductor) case in this branch's records audited for how it compiled, the comparison scripts' protocol corrected, the affected comparisons rerun. geo_compare.py, train_compare.py and infer_compare.py ran their cases in one process, each case's P-IND module through oracle.torch_model_next's one forward code object: Dynamo compiled the first case at its fixed shapes, every later case under automatic dynamic shapes (the tokens' time dynamic; in GEO-2's comparison past its first model the parameters' differing dimensions too), and past its recompile limit (8) -- GEO-2's attention training at T512 and all six of its inference cases -- compiled nothing and ran the module eagerly, warning once. Those seven P-IND readings are eager PyTorch's time, not Inductor's. The protocol now: torch._dynamo.reset() before every case, torch.compile(dynamic=False), fail_on_recompile_limit_hit (a fallback is a failure, never a timing), each compile's shape symbols and graphs recorded and checked. tools/perf/ot_torch.py's routes already compiled that way (OT-05's block a reset per shape, OT-02/OT-10/OT-11 a process per route). Records and docs only: no runtime change.
host: Intel(R) Xeon(R) Processor @ 2.30GHz, 4 vCPU (AVX-512F, AVX512-BF16 and -FP16, AMX), 2 MiB of L2 a core, 260 MiB of L3; Linux 6.18; GCC 13.3 (the level-2 and level-3 builds, as the study builds them); Python 3.11, torch 2.13.0+cu130 (CPU), NumPy 2.2.6; OMP_WAIT_POLICY=PASSIVE. GEO-2's own comparison ran on an Intel Xeon @ 2.80 GHz without AMX: geo2-rerun.json is this host's, both routes in one process

records.audit.json: audit.py: the 64 P-IND cases of the branch's records, each classified by its compile index in its process: static (the first), dynamic (1-7), eager (8 on); ot.json is clean (tools/perf/ot_torch.py)
records.witness.json: witness.py: the mechanism in one process (the second compile dynamic in time, the ninth eager, the hard failure past the limit) and the fix (a reset, dynamic=False: no symbols)
records.level3-train.json: static_compare.py --mode train: the GEO attention model's training update on SOFTMAX-T's level-3 build (B, twice) against P-EAGER, P-IND at the case's fixed shapes and P-IND-DYN (the time dimension dynamic: what train_compare.py compiled past its first case), 24 rotated rounds of 3 updates
records.level3-train-confirm.json: the declared confirmation (declared before it ran): T2048, 32 rounds
records.level3-infer.json: static_compare.py --mode infer: one forward of 4 x T, the same arms, 24 rounds
records.geo2-rerun.json: geo_compare_static.py: GEO-2's comparison (level 2's B-DIRECT, twice; P-EAGER; P-IND) with each case compiled from a fresh Dynamo state at its own fixed shapes, 12 rounds of 3 updates, as GEO-2 ran it

verdicts: each effect resolved where its 95% interval excludes 1 and does not meet the A/A control's
